percentile_definition.degree_percentile_source: Formal Step-3 degree percentile; strictly reconstructed from integer degree as QA.
percentile_definition.strength_percentile_reason: Step 3 may have computed strength percentiles from float64 strength before storing strength itself as float32. Therefore re-ranking stored strength is diagnostic only.
percentile_definition.percentile_scope: Cross-sectional within each analysis_date x window.

core_factor_definitions.delta_degree_percentile: Residual degree percentile - Raw degree percentile
core_factor_definitions.delta_strength_percentile: Residual strength percentile - Raw strength percentile

important_interpretation: Raw and Residual degree levels are directly comparable because the two networks use the same node support and the same edge budget.
Raw and Residual strength absolute levels are not interpreted as perfectly comparable economic scales because residualization changes the correlation distribution.
Therefore percentile-based Raw-Residual re-ranking is the main differential-factor definition.
No future return, future volatility, or other forward outcome is used in Step 2.
Industry decomposition, dynamic network features, and community features are intentionally deferred to later steps.
